text: Onon naafiqi'en, keeferaaku mon ngun e jalkitgol mon ngol hino wa'i wano mofte fennooɓe adinooɓe on ɓen : ɓen hino ɓurunoo on tiiɗude doole, ɓe ɓuri on jawle e ɓiɗɓe. Ɓe dakmitori geɓal maɓɓe ngal ɓe winndanaa ngal e dakamme aduna e tuuyooji mun, wano dakmitorɗon onon kadi e geɓal mon ngal sugu ɗeya mofte fennooɓe yawtuɓe no dakmitornoo, jumpuɗon e penaale yuwirɗon e Nulaaɗo on wano ɓen jumpirnoo e penaale e yuwugol Nulaaɓe maɓɓe. Ɓen siforɓe ɗin sifaaji ŋiñaaɗi, ko ɓen woni ɓe golle mun poɓiri bonugol majje ka Alla sabu keeferaaku, ko ɓen woni hayruɓe ɓen yolli=njolnii wonikiiji mun e halkaare.
